# Processor and transfer catalogue data

<!-- Generated by node ci/rule-packs/build-detection.mjs --write. -->

Exact-token catalogue rules identify Paystack, Flutterwave, Interswitch, PalmPay, OPay, NIBSS integration references, Monnify, Remita, Korapay, Dojah and Youverify, alongside AWS SDK/S3 infrastructure and two explicit AWS region settings. Every finding is a note asking the organisation to confirm processor safeguards and any transfer basis. No personal-data values are required by these cases.

Version: `2026.11.0`. Source: `rule-packs/processors.pack.json`.

The citation register records owner approval in principle; legal review remains pending. A finding requests review and does not establish a legal breach.

## Limits

Tokens indicate a reference, not actual network activity, processing, recipient role or a transfer. SDKs can be unused; region strings can occur in unrelated text. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, and does not resolve aliases or recognise arbitrary S3 virtual-hosted bucket names. Lock files stay excluded. A provider name or a Nigerian service does not establish the actual processing region: deployment and contractual arrangements require confirmation. Sandbox references also produce notes and do not establish production use. NIBSS coverage is explicitly its publicly documented developer portal reference; customer-specific API/VPN hosts, private addresses and unpublished SDK names are outside this snapshot. A portal link alone does not establish that customer data reaches that portal. OPay coverage uses the Nigerian business documentation at opayweb.com; similarly named unrelated services are excluded. The catalogue is bounded to the sourced entries below, reviewed on 6 November 2026. Processor metadata is retained in loaded rules and this reference; the existing v1 results contract reports the rule identifier and approved citation only. User-facing metadata output remains separate work under #64.

## Remediation and exceptions

Review the referenced integration and applicable contracts, record the actual data categories and processing regions, and confirm safeguards and any applicable transfer basis. Use the existing justified-exception configuration when a deliberately retained reference does not need further action.

| `transfer.processor.paystack` | customer contact details; payment and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.flutterwave` | customer contact details; payment and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.aws` | application-defined stored data | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.aws.bucket` | application-defined stored data | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.aws.ireland` | application-defined data | Europe (Ireland); confirm that this configuration is used. |
| `transfer.processor.aws.capetown` | application-defined data | Africa (Cape Town); confirm that this configuration is used. |
| `transfer.processor.interswitch` | customer contact details; payment and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.palmpay` | customer contact details; wallet, bank account and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.opay` | customer contact details; wallet and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.nibss` | identity verification and banking-service references | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.monnify` | customer contact details; bank account and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.remita` | payer contact details; bank account, mandate and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.korapay` | identity and bank account details; payment and transaction details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.dojah` | identity and bank account verification details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |
| `transfer.processor.youverify` | identity and customer verification details | Deployment-dependent; confirm the contracted processing and storage regions. |

## Verification

Run `dotnet test tests/Corpus.Tests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~DetectionPackTests` for exact locations and measured synthetic precision/recall.

These are unsigned release-source packs. Tests sign only in memory with the labelled development key. Production signing, embedding and publication are separate release operations; no development signature is shipped.
